text: ついに…　ほんとうに　ほんとうに　ものすごくて　すてきで　かんぺきな　ポケモンずかんを　かんせい　させたの　じゃな…！

structure.jp: ほんとうに　ほんとうに　ものすごくて　すてきで　かんぺきな　ポケモンずかんを
structure.en: a truly, truly tremendous, wonderful, perfect Pokédex

structure.jp: かんせい　させたの　じゃな…！
structure.en: you have completed it, haven't you...!

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: ものすごくて　すてきで　かんぺきな
patterns.explanation: Ending a describing word in くて or で lets you string several of them together, like 'and'. ものすごくて　すてきで　かんぺきな = 'tremendous, wonderful and perfect'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる after an action word means making that thing happen. かんせい　させた = 'you brought it to completion'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ after a verb shows the speaker is taking in a fact with feeling. のじゃ is the old-man form of のだ. かんせい　させたの　じゃ = 'so you really have completed it'.
